description: Is the drive across the border worth it? Official station prices in France, Austria and Italy (live / daily official sources) near a Swiss place, ranked by net saving vs the official Swiss average price (BFS) after the fuel used for the round trip. place = postcode or locality (or lat/lon). Location is used for this lookup only.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 47.56 (with lon).

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 7.59 (with lat).

place.description: Swiss place: postcode, locality or both, e.g. "8001", "Basel", "8001 Zürich" or "Basel (BS)". Alternatively give lat and lon.

name: fuel_prices_near
title: Fuel prices across the border
